notes: A clean sprint frame could come back with a squat fault it never had: the knee-tracking trip fired on every activity, so a front-view sprint with your knee a normal step ahead of your ankle was called ‘Knee tracking’ and the report sent you a squat drill for a run that scored 100. Knee tracking is now only called on squats, like squat depth and hinge back already are — a real squat with knees caving still gets called out. Real sprint faults still trip exactly as before.
